About Booking Holdings Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world’s leading provider of online travel and related services, provided to consumers and local partners in more than 220 countries and territories through five primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. For more information, visit BookingHoldings.com and follow us on X BookingHoldings. About Booking Holdings Romania: Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania, opened in September 2021. The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leveraging industry best practices, and fostering collaboration opportunities across Booking Holdings’ brands and business units. Booking Holdings Romania is supporting Booking Holdings and its portfolio of brands by providing capabilities in many important areas like Security & Fraud, Application Development, Data Analytics, Data Governance, IT End-User Support, Global Business Services, Marketing, Procurement, Legal & Compliance, Privacy, as well as Program Management Office, with new competences in other areas being added throughout the coming years.
Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania and was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of our Brands.As part of our Booking Holdings Romania team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of the worlds leading provider of online travel, with a mission of making it easier for everyone to experience the world through six-primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, OpenTable and Rentalcars.com.Role description At Booking Holdings, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world. Behind our seamless customer experience is a massive, highly complex, and relentlessly scalable infrastructure. We are looking for passionate Software Engineers to join our Bucharest Centre of Excellence and build the next generation of scalable, flexible, and high-performance systems.The Fullstack Software Engineer within Booking Holdings designs, builds, and evolves end-to-end software solutions that power Booking Holdings high-traffic platforms, delivering scalable, reliable, secure, and intuitive experiences for millions of travelers worldwide. Success means owning the full software lifecycle across frontend applications, backend services, and cloud infrastructure, from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and production support, while raising the engineering bar through mentorship, code reviews, and technical leadership across teams. The role exists to drive technical excellence and scalable software architecture within the Bucharest Centre of Excellence, supporting Booking Holdings consumer brands by providing specialized engineering talent and best practices that accelerate delivery across the organization. This role provides a hybrid way of working with an onsite presence of 2 days/week.Key Job Responsibilities and DutiesDesigns and evolves scalable, resilient full-stack systems, spanning React-based user interfaces and distributed backend services, applying sound architectural principles and technical trade-offs, in order to deliver fast, reliable, and delightful experiences to millions of users.
